svg.title: 1. Control, Delivery & GitOps
svg.text: Source to runtime, the CI federation path, and human infrastructure control. Badges state what is proven today, not what the architecture accepts.
GitLab CI/CD - per-service pipelines composed from shared templates
CI IDENTITY - federated, no static keys
PROMOTION AND ROLLBACK - accepted architecture, not yet exercised
Git revert of the digest pin;
0 publish jobs executed in the current publication epoch. 3 ECR repositories exist (astroshop/checkout, astroshop/shipping, astroshop/quote) plus
platform/opentelemetry-collector; per-service digest evidence exists, fleet-wide publication does not.
The same immutable digest moves between environment roles. Promotion is a Git
change that Argo CD reconciles; it is not a rebuild.
ADR-0009 states its implementation is not complete until one validated rollback
exercise has run. That exercise has not run, so promotion, cross-environment
promotion and rollback all remain open claims.
VALIDATED proven by captured evidence, at the badge's stated scope
PARTIAL capability exists for part of the fleet only
NOT LIVE implemented and validated in closed windows; no runtime now
PLANNED accepted or designed, not yet exercised
RETAINED survives environment teardown by design
